data.name: Blue Honey
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the mystical world of Blue Honey, an enchanting adventure where nature's deepest secrets await! Step into the shoes of a brave gatherer exploring a vibrant, forgotten realm filled with mythical creatures, glowing flora, and ancient ruins.

Your ultimate mission? To track down and harvest the legendary Blue Honey—a magical, luminescent nectar said to hold incredible, untold powers.

Key Features:

  • Explore a Magical Realm: Wander through lush, handcrafted environments, from whispering woods to crystalline caves.

  • Solve Intricate Puzzles: Use your wits and environment to overcome obstacles, unlock hidden pathways, and reach rare nectar blooms.

  • Meet Quirky Characters: Interact with the fascinating inhabitants of the forest, trade resources, and uncover their unique stories.

  • Upgrade & Customize: Enhance your harvesting gear, learn new abilities, and customize your character's playstyle as you progress.

  • A Relaxing yet Mysterious Vibe: Immerse yourself in a captivating original soundtrack and atmospheric visuals that offer a truly sweet escape.

Dive into the unknown. The forest is calling, and the Blue Honey is waiting to be found!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended for faster loading times
